Harbin Institute of Technology 2026 Chinese-taught master's degree major list

requirements.ruleText: Be a citizen of a country other than China and be in good mental and physical health.
Hold a bachelor's diploma; expected-graduation evidence is accepted at application but the original diploma is required at registration.

references.locator: I. Eligibility item 3 and II. Documents item 3

requirements.ruleText: Be under age 35; HIT Scholarship applicants must be under age 30.
Submit HSK Level 4 with at least 210, valid for two years. A certificate proving that the prior qualifying degree was taught in Chinese may be used under the published exemption.
Applications are accepted throughout the year; the deadline for the September 2026 intake is May 31, 2026.
Complete the HIT online application and upload every required record through the system; records submitted outside the system are not accepted.

references.locator: II. Application Documents and IX. Application Process

requirements.ruleText: Submit the passport information page.
Submit the bachelor's diploma or expected-graduation certificate and undergraduate transcripts.
Submit HSK Level 4 with at least 210, valid for two years. A certificate proving that the prior qualifying degree was taught in Chinese may be used under the published exemption.
Submit a study plan of at least 1,500 words using the HIT requirements/template.
Submit two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.
Submit a complete Foreigner Physical Examination Record valid within six months, including physician signature, hospital stamp and sealed photograph.
Submit a no-criminal-record report normally issued within six months before submission.
Submit a bank deposit certificate showing at least CNY 30,000 or equivalent foreign currency.
A supervisor acceptance letter is not mandatory, but applicants are encouraged to contact HIT professors before submission.
Optionally submit evidence of outstanding academic, sports, arts, cultural-exchange or public-welfare achievements.
Provide notarized Chinese or English translations for records in other languages and ensure every submitted record is authentic and valid.

references.locator: II. Application Documents opening and Important Note

requirements.ruleText: Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 application fee; HIT Scholarship applicants pay CNY 600, and self-financed applicants upload the remittance voucher.

references.locator: II. Application Documents item 10; V. Fees
